title: Morocco · Tizi n’Tichka Atlas Crossing
slogan: A 294 km loop out of Taddert fuel
story: Atlas switchbacks, heat and a proper cultural anchor. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then ride Tizi n’Tichka Pass with something in reserve. The best part sits around Tizi n’Tichka Pass, Aït Benhaddou, while Taddert fuel and the food stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

sections.advice: Use Marrakech start → Taddert fuel (71 km) as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

sections.advice: This Aït Benhaddou → Ouarzazate overnight stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Tizi n'Tichka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 20 km this is Tizi n'Tichka Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
